name: taskman-run
description: Run one of Task Manager's declared operations. Destructive rows are marked in the description — confirm with the user before running one.

command.description: taskman.item.add-child — Add sub-item; taskman.item.toggle-done — Toggle done; taskman.item.duplicate — Duplicate; taskman.item.delete — Delete item (destructive); taskman.list.new-item — New item in list; taskman.list.float — Open in floating window; taskman.list.rename — Rename list…; taskman.list.pin — Pin / unpin list; taskman.list.delete — Delete list (destructive); taskman.group.new-list — New list in this group; taskman.group.toggle — Collapse / expand group; taskman.group.rename — Rename group…; taskman.group.delete — Delete group; taskman.new-list — New list; taskman.group.add — Add group…; taskman.lists.refresh — Refresh lists; taskman.archive.open — Archived lists…; taskman.delete-all.toggle-managed — …including the build project lists; taskman.delete-all — Delete all lists (destructive)

data.description: Context the row would have carried — the item, list or selection the command acts on.
